description: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes in 3D 'miBrain' tissue (neurons, glia, myelin, cerebrovascular cells), APOE4/4 genotype; combinatorial experiments mixing cell genotypes. The comparator genotype and the specific endolysosomal assays are not stated (abstract only). Caveat: endolysosomal dysfunction and degradative capacity are not a direct measure of endosomal pH, and the direction of any pH change is not given.

provenance.excerpt: Combinatorial experiments revealed that endolysosomal dysfunction caused by cholesterol accumulation in APOE4/4 astrocytes impairs the degradation of soluble α-synuclein leading to a pathogenic transformation that seeds α-synuclein inclusions in neurons.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4/4) -> (cholesterol accumulation in astrocytes) -> (endolysosomal dysfunction, impaired α-synuclein degradation); endosomal pH not reported
